Question:
Given an undirected unweighted graph with 
N
 vertices and 
M
 edges, find the shortest distance from a given source vertex to all other vertices.

-1
.
Input Format
First line: 
N M
Next 
M
 lines: two integers 
u v
, representing an edge between 
u
 and 
v
.
Last line: source vertex.
Output Format
Print the shortest distance from the source to every vertex in order.
